mean_en: New beginnings, spontaneity, innocence, leap of faith, free spirit.
mean_rev_en: Recklessness, hesitation, naivety, poor judgment, fear of change.
love_en: new romance, emotional openness, spontaneous connection, taking a chance on love
love_rev_en: reckless romance, fear of commitment, naive expectations, leaping without looking
career_en: new career path, taking a professional risk, entrepreneurial leap, learning through experience
career_rev_en: reckless decisions, poor planning, fear of starting, missed timing
mean_zh: 一段嶄新旅程展開，帶着純真與勇氣放手一搏，相信未知自有它的安排。
mean_rev_zh: 警惕憑衝動行事或過分天真，前路未明時，先停下來想清楚再出發。
love_zh: 新戀情隨緣而至，帶着純真心去認識，享受探索的樂趣。
love_rev_zh: 感情中勿輕率投入或逃避承諾，先想清自己真正想要甚麼。
career_zh: 事業迎來新機會或轉行契機，大膽一試，拼勁會為你開路。
career_rev_zh: 職場上忌衝動跳槽或準備不足，先做好功課纔行動。
health_zh: 正位：身體狀態煥然一新，係開始新健康習慣或療程嘅好時機，放膽踏出第一步。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：唔理身體警號，又或者過度冒險，諗住冇事就唔去檢查，小心因掉以輕心而搞出大病。
health_en: Upright: A fresh start for your body—great timing to launch a new health routine or treatment with boldness and curiosity.
health_rev_en: Reversed: Ignoring warning signs or taking reckless health risks; skipping check-ups out of false confidence could backfire.
wealth_zh: 新財務方向適合以小額、低成本的試驗起步，例如先買一個月費工具試學，而唔好未計清回報就大筆投入。
wealth_rev_zh: 衝動起錨或過度理想化可能令你高估收入、快速借貸或盲目創業；落決定前先停一晚，寫低最壞情境同可以承受的損失。
wealth_en: Wealth favors testing a new income idea on a small, low-cost scale before committing substantial money.
wealth_rev_en: Avoid chasing a quick payoff; pause, write down the downside, and keep any experiment within an amount you can afford to lose.
study_zh: 你帶住好奇心跳入新科目，就算未準備好都肯試，呢個係你學習旅程嘅起點。
study_rev_zh: 明明唔熟就衝住去考試，或者因為怕失敗而遲遲唔開始溫書，兩邊都係陷阱。
study_en: You leap into a brand-new subject with fearless curiosity, ready to learn by doing even before you feel ready.
study_rev_en: You either rush into exams unprepared or stall out of fear of failure—both extremes leave your studies stuck.
family_zh: 一家人迎來新開始，可能有新成員加入或者搬新居，帶住純真同冒險心去創造家庭回憶。
family_rev_zh: 一時衝動做家庭決定，或者對家庭責任猶豫，缺乏計劃搞到屋企亂曬。
family_en: A fresh start in family life—welcome a new member or move to a new home with innocence and a spirit of adventure.
family_rev_en: Rash family decisions or hesitation to commit to family responsibilities; lack of planning may throw the household into chaos.

mean_en: Manifestation, willpower, resourcefulness, skill, focused action.
mean_rev_en: Manipulation, untapped talent, scattered energy, trickery, illusion.
love_en: strong attraction, romantic initiative, clear intentions, creating the relationship you desire
love_rev_en: manipulation, mixed signals, unfulfilled potential, deception in romance
career_en: skillful execution, using available resources, career initiative, turning ideas into results
career_rev_en: wasted talent, scattered focus, misused skills, unrealized plans
mean_zh: 你的資源與才能齊備，集中意志付諸行動，便能將想法化為現實。
mean_rev_zh: 小心被表象迷惑或受人操控；才能尚未發揮，先整頓渙散的心思。
love_zh: 主動出擊的時刻，展現你的魅力與誠意，對方會同樣回應。
love_rev_zh: 小心言語或行為上的操控，確保關係建立在真誠之上。
career_zh: 手握足夠資源與技能，專注執行便能交出亮眼成績。
career_rev_zh: 當心誇大承諾或走捷徑，整頓專注力，實幹勝於巧言。
health_zh: 正位：你握有齊所需嘅意志力同資源，只要集中行動，身體康復嘅效果會好快顯現。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：能量太散亂，或者呃自己話「冇事」；有康復能力但冇善用，甚至被錯誤資訊誤導。
health_en: Upright: You have all the tools and willpower needed for healing—focused action will make the health results appear swiftly.
health_rev_en: Reversed: Scattered energy or self-deception about your condition; your healing potential is untapped or being misdirected by wrong advice.
wealth_zh: 盤點可以變現的技能同身邊資源，選一項做成產品或服務，再以清晰報價將想法化成實際收入。
wealth_rev_zh: 過度吹噓、發夢冇算帳或一個計畫都做一半，會令資源白白消耗；先驗證市場需求，再集中資源完成一項服務。
wealth_en: Turn one practical skill and an available resource into a clearly priced offer that can generate real income.
wealth_rev_en: Guard against inflated claims, tricks, and scattered projects; verify demand and refine one offer before investing further.
study_zh: 你手上有齊筆記、老師同時間，只要集中精神專攻一個課題，成績就會即刻見到成效。
study_rev_zh: 你有能力但分散曬注意力，學好多樣都半桶水，仲有機會用取巧方法呃自己呃老師。
study_en: With your notes, teachers, and time all in hand, focused action on one topic turns your efforts into visible results.
study_rev_en: Your talent is real but scattered across too many subjects, leaving you with shallow knowledge and tempting shortcuts that only fool yourself.
family_zh: 用自己嘅技能同資源去解決家庭問題，主動安排家庭活動，將理想家庭具體化。
family_rev_zh: 喺家庭關係入面玩弄手段，或者潛能未發揮，淨係靠把口而冇實際行動。
family_en: Use your skills and resources to solve family issues, take initiative to organize family activities, and turn your ideal home into reality.
family_rev_en: Manipulation within family relationships, or untapped potential—all talk with no real action.

mean_en: Intuition, inner wisdom, mystery, the subconscious, stillness.
mean_rev_en: Ignored intuition, secrets, disconnection from self, hidden agendas, surface knowledge.
love_en: unspoken feelings, emotional intuition, hidden attraction, a private or mysterious connection
love_rev_en: ignored intuition, hidden feelings, secrecy, emotional disconnection
career_en: trusting professional intuition, working behind the scenes, confidential matters, patient observation
career_rev_en: overlooked information, surface knowledge, hidden agendas, ignored instincts
mean_zh: 答案藏在靜默之中，相信直覺與潛意識的訊息，不必急於向外追問。
mean_rev_zh: 直覺被忽略，或有意外的隱瞞；靜下心，別只停留在表面的理解。
love_zh: 感情發展未明，多聆聽直覺與對方的心聲，不必急於表白或定位。
love_rev_zh: 忽略直覺或隱瞞心事只會拉開距離；坦誠交流是解鎖關鍵。
career_zh: 適合觀察與沉澱，答案會浮現；你也可以等待更佳時機出手。
career_rev_zh: 職場訊息或同事動機未明，別只信表面，重要決定先核實。
health_zh: 正位：信任你嘅身體直覺，留意夢境同潛意識訊息，靜落嚟聆聽，身體會話你知佢需要咩。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：你忽略咗內在聲音，對自己嘅健康狀況一知半解，或者有隱藏嘅病徵未肯面對。
health_en: Upright: Trust your body’s intuition and quiet inner signals—listen in stillness and your physical needs will be revealed.
health_rev_en: Reversed: You are tuning out your intuition and staying surface-level about your health; hidden symptoms are being overlooked.
wealth_zh: 靜靜對帳可能會發現一筆隱藏收費、長供服務費或被你忽略的收入機會，尤其要先睇清楚細字條款。
wealth_rev_zh: 唔理會心裡對花費或投資嘅警告，好可能會將表面睇落穩陣嘅安排交託給人；先披露實況、問清細節，再決定是否交易。
wealth_en: Your intuition may quietly sense a hidden cost, so slow down and check bank statements, subscriptions, and contract fine print before acting.
wealth_rev_en: Ignoring a warning about money can cloud your judgment; bring the facts to light, ask direct questions, and postpone any deal you cannot explain.
study_zh: 溫書唔單止睇表面，仲要靜低聽直覺，你其實好快就會「叮」一聲明曬背後嘅原理。
study_rev_zh: 你忽略咗自己嘅直覺，淨係死記例子，冇留意到隱藏嘅重點，考試一轉彎就失分。
study_en: Study beyond the surface—your intuition connects the dots behind the material, and quiet reflection unlocks understanding.
study_rev_en: You're cramming facts without listening to that inner nudge, missing the hidden core so you stumble the moment the exam twists a question.
family_zh: 傾聽直覺同家庭嘅潛在需要，唔好急住講出口，用靜默去感受屋企嘅氣氛。
family_rev_zh: 無視家人嘅暗示，或者屋企有祕密隱瞞，同自己內心失去連結。
family_en: Trust your intuition and the unspoken needs of your family; stay still and sense the atmosphere at home.
family_rev_en: Ignoring your family's subtle cues, or hidden secrets at home; disconnection from your own inner voice.

mean_en: Abundance, nurturing, fertility, creativity, sensuality.
mean_rev_en: Creative block, smothering, self-neglect, dependence, stagnation.
love_en: nurturing love, affection, sensuality, emotional abundance
love_rev_en: smothering, neglect, dependence, blocked affection
career_en: creative growth, supportive workplace, productive abundance, nurturing a project
career_rev_en: creative block, stagnation, lack of support, unproductive effort
mean_zh: 豐盛與滋養的時刻，善待身心，讓創造力與愛自然生長。
mean_rev_zh: 小心過度付出或忽略自己；創作停滯時，先好好照顧自己的需要。
love_zh: 關係沐浴在溫柔與滋養之中，愛情自然茁壯，多享受相處時光。
love_rev_zh: 過度付出或依賴會令人窒息，留空間給彼此，先照顧好自己。
career_zh: 創作與合作項目開花結果，以耐心孕育，成果會更豐碩。
career_rev_zh: 當心計劃停滯或過度操勞，重拾熱情，平衡工作與生活。
health_zh: 正位：身體處於豐盛滋養嘅狀態，要以溫柔方式善待自己，對備孕或調理虛弱都好有利。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：過度放縱或忽略自我照顧，搞到身體停滯、失衡；滋養不足，免疫力自然下降。
health_en: Upright: Your body is in an abundant, nurturing phase—self-care and gentle nourishment will boost fertility and overall vitality.
health_rev_en: Reversed: Self-neglect or overindulgence has left your body stagnant and depleted; a lack of true nourishment is weakening you.
wealth_zh: 親手灌溉的創作項目，例如小型品牌、版權產品或支援完善的服務，有機會長成穩定收入；同時要預留維持項目及照顧自己嘅本錢。
wealth_rev_zh: 當創作停滯又過度依賴他人，你可以先削減非必要開支，保護時間與資金畀真正有回饋嘅項目。
wealth_en: A patiently nurtured creative venture can develop into a generous income stream while you protect its operating costs and personal needs.
wealth_rev_en: A blocked income stream can grow into dependency or neglect; cut unnecessary commitments and protect time and money for work that truly nourishes you.
study_zh: 你用創作同美感去整理筆記，將枯燥內容變成有生命力嘅知識，成績會慢慢茁壯成長。
study_rev_zh: 你諗極都冇新點子，溫到悶曬而停滯不前，小心過度照顧其他嘢而忽略自己嘅進度。
study_en: Bring creativity and care to your notes, turning dry material into living knowledge that steadily grows into strong grades.
study_rev_en: Your mind feels blocked and the material has gone stale; you may be over-nurturing distractions while neglecting your own study progress.
family_zh: 家庭充滿豐盛同關懷，照顧家人如同孕育生命，創造溫馨而滋養嘅環境。
family_rev_zh: 過度保護令人透唔到氣，或者忽略自己需要，創造力停滯，家庭氣氛變沉悶。
family_en: The family is abundant and nurturing—caring for loved ones like tending a garden, creating a warm, nourishing home.
family_rev_en: Smothering care that suffocates, or self-neglect; creative stagnation makes the home feel heavy and dull.

mean_en: Structure, authority, stability, leadership, discipline.
mean_rev_en: Rigidity, control issues, domination, lack of discipline, abuse of power.
love_en: commitment, stability, protection, a structured relationship
love_rev_en: control issues, rigidity, domination, emotional coldness
career_en: leadership, structure, authority, long-term career stability
career_rev_en: abuse of power, inflexibility, lack of discipline, unstable authority
mean_zh: 以結構與紀律建立穩固基礎，果斷領導，事情會按軌道前進。
mean_rev_zh: 當心權力失衡或過分僵化；放下控制慾，彈性才能帶來真正的穩定。
love_zh: 關係需要穩定與承擔，明確的承諾與規劃會讓彼此更有安全感。
love_rev_zh: 控制慾或過分嚴肅會令感情變冷，學習柔軟，讓對方感到被尊重。
career_zh: 事業步入軌道，以紀律與領導力推進，適時擔起更高責任。
career_rev_zh: 當心權力僵化或專斷，願意聆聽下屬與同事，才能走得更遠。
health_zh: 正位：用紀律同規律去管理健康最有效，定時作息、恆常運動，身體自然穩如泰山。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：對健康管理太死板，逼到自己喘不過氣，又或者完全冇紀律放縱自己，兩極都傷身。
health_en: Upright: Discipline and structure are your best medicine—regular sleep and consistent exercise will keep your body stable and strong.
health_rev_en: Reversed: You are either obsessively rigid about health or utterly undisciplined; both extremes are stressing and breaking your body.
wealth_zh: 訂立每月預算、儲蓄緩衝同還債次序，用清晰規則掌控收入，長期穩定比追逐快錢更為實際。
wealth_rev_zh: 管得太死會錯過變化，放得太鬆又會入不敷出；將預算分成必要開支、儲蓄同可自由花費，突發支出先由緩衝應付。
wealth_en: A clear budget, financial safety buffer, and prioritized debt plan can turn steady income into long-term security.
wealth_rev_en: Financial control becomes counterproductive when it is rigid or absent; build flexible categories, set limits, and clarify shared-money responsibilities where relevant.
study_zh: 訂立清晰嘅溫書時間表同規矩，用紀律去執行，你嘅學習系統會穩固到考試都動搖唔到。
study_rev_zh: 時間表太死板或者完全冇紀律，一時逼得太緊，一時放縱自己，進度因而失衡。
study_en: A clear study schedule with firm rules and disciplined execution builds a knowledge system the exam cannot shake.
study_rev_en: Your schedule is either too rigid or completely nonexistent—alternating between burnout and indulgence throws your progress off balance.
family_zh: 建立家庭規矩同穩定結構，用紀律同權威保護家人，做家庭嘅支柱。
family_rev_zh: 太死板或者獨裁，控制慾過強，令家人反抗；缺乏紀律令家庭混亂。
family_en: Establish clear family rules and a stable structure; use discipline and authority to protect and lead the household.
family_rev_en: Rigidity and domination that provoke rebellion; lack of discipline may lead to household chaos.

mean_en: Tradition, guidance, shared values, institutions, mentorship.
mean_rev_en: Rebellion, questioning convention, restriction, dogma, breaking rules.
love_en: traditional commitment, shared values, marriage, spiritual partnership
love_rev_en: unconventional bond, mismatched values, questioning commitment, breaking tradition
career_en: established institutions, mentorship, formal training, conventional career path
career_rev_en: rebellion against structure, rejecting convention, restrictive institution, dogmatic workplace
mean_zh: 循傳統與長者的智慧而行，跟從既有體制與共同價值會更加安心。
mean_rev_zh: 是時候質疑僵化的規條；忠於內心，別讓教條綁住你的選擇。
love_zh: 關係可有長輩或傳統祝福，循步漸進的發展會更穩固。
love_rev_zh: 質疑被教條綁住的感情觀，找出屬於你們自己的相處方式。
career_zh: 跟從既有制度與導師指引會少走彎路，學習前輩經驗。
career_rev_zh: 不必盲從公司潛規則，合理打破框架或另覓合適環境。
health_zh: 正位：跟從專業醫護或正規醫療嘅指引，用經實證嘅傳統方法調理，身體會穩步好轉。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：質疑甚至抗拒正規醫療，或過度迷信單一療法，反而延誤病情，令自己受苦。
health_en: Upright: Follow professional medical guidance and evidence-based, conventional methods—your health will improve steadily under this structure.
health_rev_en: Reversed: Rebelling against proper medical advice or clinging dogmatically to one remedy is delaying recovery and causing more harm.
wealth_zh: 穩健而適合自己的財務習慣，或向有資歷、持牌嘅專業人士取經，可以減少試錯並建立長遠基礎。
wealth_rev_zh: 如果因為傳統、權威或怕被評議而亂跟方案，隨時會買咗貴而唔適合的產品；先比較費用、風險同回報，再決定採用或改變規則。
wealth_en: A time-tested budgeting framework or guidance from a qualified adviser can help you build wealth without unnecessary trial and error.
wealth_rev_en: Do not follow expensive conventions simply because others approve of them; compare fees, risks, and suitability while keeping only rules that serve your goals.
study_zh: 跟實老師嘅指引同傳統學習方法，穩陣咁一步步跟課程行，基礎會打得特別實。
study_rev_zh: 你抗拒學校嘅規矩同教法，一味想自己創新路，結果偏離課程重點，考試時先嚟後悔。
study_en: Follow your teacher's guidance and the established curriculum step by step; this traditional path gives you an unshakeable foundation.
study_rev_en: Rebelling against school rules and textbook methods, you chase your own path until drifting off the syllabus—then regret hits at exam time.
family_zh: 尊重家庭傳統同共同價值，跟從長輩教誨，或者透過儀式強化家庭連結。
family_rev_zh: 反抗家庭規矩，質疑傳統價值，覺得受束縛，想脫離家庭規範。
family_en: Honour family traditions and shared values; follow elders' guidance and strengthen bonds through rituals.
family_rev_en: Rebelling against family rules and questioning traditions; feeling restricted and wanting to break free from family norms.

mean_en: Love, union, alignment, meaningful choice, harmony.
mean_rev_en: Disharmony, misalignment, avoidance of choice, temptation, imbalance.
love_en: deep connection, mutual attraction, relationship choices, emotional alignment
love_rev_en: disharmony, misalignment, avoided choices, values clash
career_en: aligned career choice, productive partnership, values-based decision, important professional commitment
career_rev_en: misaligned decision, conflicting priorities, broken partnership, poor commitment
mean_zh: 真誠的連結與和諧出現，也可能需要在感情或價值上作出重要的抉擇。
mean_rev_zh: 關係中出現分歧或誘惑；逃避選擇只會令失衡加深，坦誠是第一步。
love_zh: 真愛與心靈契合的象徵，重要抉擇前先誠實面對自己的心。
love_rev_zh: 關係出現分歧或抉擇壓力，坦誠溝通，別讓誘惑動搖你。
career_zh: 事業抉擇或合作結盟出現，選擇與你價值觀一致的夥伴。
career_rev_zh: 當心團隊目標不一或騎牆心態，明確立場才能向前。
health_zh: 正位：身心合一嘅重要時刻，要為健康作出忠於自己嘅選擇，同身體好好「溝通」就自然和諧。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：身心失衡，可能因為感情或人際壓力而影響健康，又或者明知有害都照做，選擇咗傷害自己。
health_en: Upright: A moment of mind-body alignment—making values-based choices for your health will restore harmony and wholeness.
health_rev_en: Reversed: Disharmony between your emotions and body; relationship stress or self-harming choices are creating imbalance and poor health.
wealth_zh: 先寫低你最重視的生活目標，再將同一筆收入分配予慳錢、體驗同喜愛嘅事；若有伴侶，亦要坦誠傾清楚共同開支同儲蓄界線。
wealth_rev_zh: 金錢優先次序不一致，再甜蜜嘅關係都會暗生摩擦；唔好迴避對話，宜共同列出必需支出、各自預算同共同目標。
wealth_en: Allocate income around what matters most to you, and if partnered, discuss shared expenses, personal budgets, and savings goals openly.
wealth_rev_en: Unspoken differences over spending can strain even a loving relationship; stop avoiding the topic and agree on essentials, individual limits, and joint priorities.
study_zh: 選科同做研習題目時，你揀啱咗同自己價值觀一致嘅方向，學習自然投入又有熱情。
study_rev_zh: 你夾硬考一科根本冇興趣嘅嘢，或喺兩個方向之間猶豫不決，搞到心緒不寧溫唔入腦。
study_en: Choosing subjects or research topics aligned with your true values turns study into passionate, wholehearted engagement.
study_rev_en: Forcing yourself through a subject you don't care about, or wavering between two options, fills you with turmoil and nothing sinks in.
family_zh: 家庭成員之間心意相通，做重要決定時考慮所有人嘅價值，關係和諧。
family_rev_zh: 家庭內部出現分歧同唔協調，逃避面對選擇，令關係失去平衡。
family_en: Harmony and alignment within the family; make meaningful choices that honour everyone's values.
family_rev_en: Disharmony and misalignment in the family; avoiding tough choices throws relationships off balance.

mean_en: Determination, victory, willpower, self-control, momentum.
mean_rev_en: Lack of direction, aggression, obstacles, scattered forces, loss of control.
love_en: pursuing love, relationship progress, shared direction, overcoming romantic obstacles
love_rev_en: loss of direction, opposing goals, romantic obstacles, lack of control
career_en: ambition, focused progress, overcoming competition, taking control of your career
career_rev_en: scattered forces, stalled ambition, loss of control, aggressive competition
mean_zh: 憑決心與自制駕馭力量，向前衝，勝利就在眼前。
mean_rev_zh: 力量渙散或方向不清，先找回重心，別讓衝動接管方向盤。
love_zh: 感情進展加速，主動表達與行動會讓關係更進一步。
love_rev_zh: 當心衝動或用力過猛，感情需要節奏，別只顧自己向前衝。
career_zh: 目標明確、勢頭正盛，排除障礙後有望取得勝利。
career_rev_zh: 力量渙散或方向混亂，先定出優先次序再衝刺。
health_zh: 正位：用強勁意志力同自控力推動康復進程，保持勢頭，疾病好快會被你拋離。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：健康管理失去方向，被情緒或壓力扯住走；失去自控，身體問題可能會一發不可收拾。
health_en: Upright: Drive your recovery with focused willpower and self-mastery—keep the momentum and illness will soon be left behind.
health_rev_en: Reversed: Lack of direction and emotional spirals are derailing your health efforts; loss of self-control is letting symptoms escalate.
wealth_zh: 將財富目標收窄成一個可量化方向，例如指定期限內儲滿三個月開支，並每星期檢查進度，勝過同時追十個投資計劃。
wealth_rev_zh: 過度追數、互相競爭或急功近利，會誘使你用借貸追收入、亂加倉；先定止蝕位同資源上限，再集中處理首要目標。
wealth_en: Choose one measurable wealth goal, minimize distractions, and review progress weekly so focused action builds reliable momentum.
wealth_rev_en: Competitive pressure and impatience can drive overspending or reckless leverage; set spending and risk limits before pursuing a single priority.
study_zh: 你鬥志旺盛，用意志力控制溫書節奏，一路向前衝，就快完成最後一科嘅勝利。
study_rev_zh: 你失去方向，唔知自己溫到邊度，又衝得太快撞板，停低重整路線先會行得返正軌。
study_en: Your fierce willpower drives a disciplined study pace straight through obstacles toward that final victory.
study_rev_en: Without a clear direction you overdrive into walls, scattering your forces—stop and realign to find your forward path again.
family_zh: 憑決心同自律帶領家庭走出困境，目標一致，排除障礙向前。
family_rev_zh: 失去方向，家庭各人力量分散，或者脾氣失控，令計劃受阻。
family_en: With determination and self-control, steer the family through challenges—united goals and forward momentum.
family_rev_en: Loss of direction, scattered family energy, or uncontrolled anger that stalls progress.

mean_en: Courage, inner strength, patience, compassion, gentle power.
mean_rev_en: Self-doubt, raw emotion, impatience, insecurity, forcing.
love_en: patience in love, gentle devotion, emotional courage, compassionate support
love_rev_en: self-doubt, impatience, emotional insecurity, forcing connection
career_en: quiet leadership, professional confidence, patience under pressure, managing challenges with composure
career_rev_en: low confidence, impatience, pressure mishandled, self-doubt
mean_zh: 真正的力量是溫柔而堅定；以耐心與慈悲應對，馴服內心的猛獸。
mean_rev_zh: 當心自我懷疑與急躁，越是用力越易失控；先安頓情緒再行動。
love_zh: 以溫柔與耐心經營，馴服情緒後的真誠最能打動對方。
love_rev_zh: 當心情緒起伏或自我懷疑，給自己空間，別把不安拋給對方。
career_zh: 以柔克剛，處理棘手同事或項目時，耐心比強硬更有效。
career_rev_zh: 過度強迫或壓抑會累積壓力，適時求助，別硬撐。
health_zh: 正位：唔使急，用溫柔而堅定嘅態度面對疾病，內在力量會支持你熬過漫長嘅康復之路。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：對康復冇曬信心，心急想快啲好返；焦慮同自我懷疑反而令身體更虛弱。
health_en: Upright: Face illness with gentle, patient courage—your deep inner strength will carry you through even the slowest recovery.
health_rev_en: Reversed: Impatience and self-doubt about your body are draining your energy; forcing recovery only weakens you further.
wealth_zh: 溫柔而持續的力量適合用來守錢：設定自動轉帳預留儲蓄、每次加薪先增加儲蓄比例，耐心讓小習慣慢慢變成安全感。
wealth_rev_zh: 因恐懼走樣而衝動投資、急住證明自己，或以大量消費紓壓，都會消耗財力；先停一停，寫清目標同限制纔出手。
wealth_en: Build wealth through gentle consistency, such as automatically saving part of each pay cheque and increasing the percentage whenever income rises.
wealth_rev_en: Do not spend or invest to quiet anxiety or prove your worth; pause, define the goal and risk limit, and let calm guide the decision.
study_zh: 面對艱深課題保持耐性，用溫柔嘅毅力慢慢馴服難點，內在力量會令你越嚟越自信。
study_rev_zh: 你懷疑自己能力，越急越亂，仲夾硬要死記入腦，結果壓力爆煲，溫極都唔入。
study_en: Meet challenging topics with patient determination, gently taming each difficulty until quiet inner power builds your confidence.
study_rev_en: Self-doubt and rushing force-feed your brain, so pressure mounts and nothing sticks—ease up before you crack.
family_zh: 用溫柔同耐性去安撫家人情緒，以內在力量化解衝突，做全家嘅定心丸。
family_rev_zh: 失去自信或者躁底，強迫家人就範，反而令關係更脆弱。
family_en: Use gentle patience and inner strength to calm emotional storms and resolve conflicts—be the family's anchor.
family_rev_en: Self-doubt or impatience; forcing family members to comply only weakens the bond.

mean_en: Introspection, solitude, inner guidance, wisdom, searching.
mean_rev_en: Isolation, loneliness, withdrawal, lost direction, avoidance.
love_en: time alone, romantic introspection, emotional distance, understanding personal needs
love_rev_en: isolation, emotional withdrawal, loneliness, avoiding connection
career_en: independent work, career reflection, specialist expertise, seeking meaningful direction
career_rev_en: isolation at work, lost direction, avoidance, excessive solitude
mean_zh: 退一步沉澱，獨處中自有答案；提燈前行，智慧會在你內心生長。
mean_rev_zh: 當心退縮成孤立，過度的獨處令人迷失；適時向外界伸出援手。
love_zh: 感情需要沉澱與自我整理，獨處後你會更清楚自己想要甚麼。
love_rev_zh: 當心退縮成疏離，給對方多一點回應，別讓關係在沉默中冷卻。
career_zh: 適合研究與自我進修，默默打好根基，機會不久將至。
career_rev_zh: 過度孤立或閉門造車會錯失訊息，走出辦公室與人交流。
health_zh: 正位：身體需要靜修同獨處，畀自己時間沉澱，傾聽內在智慧，先搵到最適合嘅養生方法。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：過度自我封閉，唔肯求助亦唔肯鬱動，孤獨感會蠶食身心健康，令情況惡化。
health_en: Upright: Your body craves solitude and rest—retreat inward, listen to your own wisdom, and you will find the healing method you need.
health_rev_en: Reversed: Isolation has gone too far; refusing help and avoiding movement is letting loneliness eat away at your physical and mental health.
wealth_zh: 暫停衝入不明朗產品，用一段安靜時間檢視開支、收入同真正需要，再比較方案，往往比不停睇新聞更能發現長遠機會。
wealth_rev_zh: 長期「自己研究」而唔肯求助，可能錯過專業資訊，亦會將孤獨變成財務盲點；主動問問可信顧問，再保留獨立判斷。
wealth_en: Take quiet time to review expenses, income, and genuine needs before comparing investments or other unfamiliar money opportunities.
wealth_rev_en: Excessive self-reliance can leave you isolated and uninformed; ask a trusted adviser for insight while retaining independent judgment about every decision.
study_zh: 暫時遠離人羣，一個人靜靜咁深入諗透概念，呢段獨處會令你搵到根治問題嘅見解。
study_rev_zh: 你縮埋一角逃避溫習，搞到同外界斷絕連繫，淨係自己鑽牛角尖，落得卡住冇進展。
study_en: Step back from distractions and study alone in stillness; deep solo reflection reveals the core insight that cracks your confusion.
study_rev_en: You're withdrawing into a corner to escape studying, losing connection with resources, and spiraling into lonely rumination with no progress.
family_zh: 需要空間獨處去諗清楚家庭方向，或者用智慧引導家人走過難關。
family_rev_zh: 過度離羣令家人擔心，或者孤立自己逃避家庭責任，迷失方向。
family_en: Step back for quiet reflection to understand the family's path; use hard-earned wisdom to guide loved ones.
family_rev_en: Excessive withdrawal worries the family; isolation becomes avoidance of duty and leaves you lost.

mean_en: Change, cycles, destiny, turning point, luck.
mean_rev_en: Resistance to change, bad luck, repeating cycles, setbacks, clinging.
love_en: change in love, unexpected encounter, relationship turning point, repeating romantic cycles
love_rev_en: repeating patterns, bad timing, romantic setbacks, resistance to change
career_en: changing opportunities, career turning point, unexpected progress, adapting to professional cycles
career_rev_en: setbacks, missed opportunities, bad luck, clinging to the past
mean_zh: 命運之輪正在轉動，轉捩點與機遇到來，順勢而為自有新局。
mean_rev_zh: 抗拒改變或重蹈舊循環；鬆開執着，壞運過後必見轉機。
love_zh: 緣分正在流轉，順其自然，合適的人會在對的時刻出現。
love_rev_zh: 感情陷入重複循環時，主動打破慣性，壞運不會永遠持續。
career_zh: 時來運到，趁勢而上，把握轉捩點帶來的機遇。
career_rev_zh: 當心計劃被打亂，保持彈性，別死抓住已經過時的安排。
health_zh: 正位：健康運勢迎來轉捩點，好快會有好轉或新契機，順住個勢調整生活節奏就啱。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：身體問題不斷重複輪迴，源於抗拒改變舊有習慣；唔肯放手，運氣就幫唔到你。
health_en: Upright: A turning point in your health is here—good fortune is moving in your favor, so ride the momentum by adapting your lifestyle.
health_rev_en: Reversed: Recurring health issues stem from resistance to change; clinging to old habits keeps you stuck in the same negative cycle.
wealth_zh: 收入有起必有落，新工作、年中獎金或市場調整帶來的意外機會，可以先加厚儲備，再逐步考慮長線配置。
wealth_rev_zh: 執住舊賺錢方法、錯過轉機，或因一次挫折就認定所有轉變都唔可信，只會重複同一循環；先備妥現金流，再逐步改變策略。
wealth_en: Unexpected changes can create openings, so direct windfalls toward your safety buffer before considering longer-term commitments.
wealth_rev_en: Clinging to an outdated method or resisting every change can trap you in a costly cycle; build a cash buffer and adjust one decision at a time.
study_zh: 學習運勢正在轉動，可能係成績大翻身嘅轉捩點，捉住個勢順住個循環去溫就會有好消息。
study_rev_zh: 你死守舊有溫習方法，抗拒考試模式改變，結果不斷重複犯錯，轉機遲遲唔嚟。
study_en: The wheel turns in your favor—this is a turning point where a changed study rhythm can suddenly transform your grades.
study_rev_en: Clinging to old study habits and resisting new exam patterns, you repeat the same mistakes and the breakthrough keeps slipping away.
family_zh: 家庭迎來轉變，可能係添丁、搬遷、或者好運帶嚟新氣象，順應循環。
family_rev_zh: 抗拒家庭變遷，或者壞消息打亂計劃，舊有問題重演，死攬唔放。
family_en: The family enters a turning point—a new arrival, relocation, or lucky shift; embrace the cycle of change.
family_rev_en: Resisting family changes, unforeseen setbacks, or repeating old patterns by clinging to the past.

mean_en: Fairness, truth, accountability, cause and effect, clarity.
mean_rev_en: Unfairness, dishonesty, avoiding accountability, bias, imbalance.
love_en: honesty, relationship balance, accountability, fair decisions in love
love_rev_en: dishonesty, imbalance, avoided accountability, unfairness
career_en: fair evaluation, contracts and legal matters, accountable decisions, merit-based outcome
career_rev_en: unfair outcome, dishonest dealings, avoided responsibility, bias
mean_zh: 以公正與真相衡量一切，種下的因自有其果，結果終會明朗。
mean_rev_zh: 當心偏見或不公的裁決；誠實面對責任，失衡終須修正。
love_zh: 關係需要公平與平衡，坦誠相待，付出與回報自然會對等。
love_rev_zh: 當心偏見或不公造成裂痕，正視問題，別逃避該負的責任。
career_zh: 努力得到應有評價，合約與法律事宜也會如你所願。
career_rev_zh: 職場可能存在不公或隱瞞，保存證據，以理據爭取公平。
health_zh: 正位：要如實面對自己嘅健康狀況，搵出真正病因；因果分明，對症下藥先可以真正康復。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：唔肯面對現實，覺得「點解係我」，將責任推畀人；逃避真相只會令身體繼續失衡。
health_en: Upright: Give yourself an honest health assessment—understand the true cause-and-effect behind your symptoms and treat the real root.
health_rev_en: Reversed: Avoiding accountability and asking 'why me' is blocking recovery; ignoring the truth is keeping your body out of balance.
wealth_zh: 逐項核對收入、稅項、帳單、佣金同合約，將條件寫清楚並按時記帳，可望減少爭議，亦令賺咗幾多變得一目瞭然。
wealth_rev_zh: 忽略一筆錯誤帳單、漏報收入或合同條款，睇落小問題可以愈滾愈大；立即更正紀錄，必要時追討欠款或尋求專業意見。
wealth_en: Check income, taxes, bills, commissions, and contracts carefully, then keep clear records to reduce disputes and make your real position transparent.
wealth_rev_en: A neglected billing error, missing payment, or unclear contract term can compound quickly; correct the record now and seek professional help if needed.
study_zh: 平時付出幾多努力，考試就會攞返相應嘅分數，呢科係公平嘅，你嘅誠實溫習必然有回報。
study_rev_zh: 你可能想走捷徑或者心諗有偏私，記住成績睇因果，取巧同失衡最終會令你付出代價。
study_en: Your grades will match the effort you invest—this exam is fair, and honest, balanced preparation is bound to bring its due reward.
study_rev_en: Temptation to cut corners or resentment about unfairness clouds your judgment; remember that cause and effect will balance the score in the end.
family_zh: 家庭入面講公平同真相，分配責任要公道，有錯要認，以誠實維繫關係。
family_rev_zh: 偏心、隱瞞或者逃避責任，令家庭成員覺得受委屈，關係失衡。
family_en: Seek fairness and truth within the family—distribute duties equitably, own your mistakes, and build trust through honesty.
family_rev_en: Favouritism, deceit, or dodging accountability leaves family members feeling wronged and unbalanced.

mean_en: Surrender, new perspective, pause, letting go, suspension.
mean_rev_en: Stalling, resistance, martyrdom, indecision, wasted sacrifice.
love_en: romantic pause, changing perspective, emotional surrender, waiting for clarity
love_rev_en: stalling, resistance, needless sacrifice, indecision
career_en: career pause, delayed progress, new perspective, reconsidering professional priorities
career_rev_en: stalled progress, resistance to change, wasted delay, indecision
mean_zh: 暫停不是停滯，是為了換一個角度；放下掌控，答案自會呈現。
mean_rev_zh: 拖延與抗拒只會令你困在原地；別再白白犧牲，是時候作出決定。
love_zh: 暫停腳步看清關係全貌，換個角度，答案與解脫同時到來。
love_rev_zh: 拖延或自我犧牲不會解決問題，勇敢面對纔是轉機。
career_zh: 事業需要沉澱與創新思考，先蹲低，是為了跳得更高。
career_rev_zh: 當心卡在進退兩難，拖得愈久代價愈大，是時候作決定。
health_zh: 正位：暫時放低手頭上嘅一切，俾身體好好休息；換個角度睇自己嘅健康，會有大發現。
health_rev_zh: 逆位：死撐唔肯休息，仲要用「犧牲捱義氣」心態逼自己繼續；咁樣只會拖慢康復，搞到身體反噬。
health_en: Upright: Pause and surrender to the healing process—letting go of control and gaining a new perspective will unlock your recovery.
health_rev_en: Reversed: Stubbornly refusing to rest and martyring yourself to overwork is stalling your healing; your body will eventually force the stop.
wealth_zh: 有時最實際嘅增值行動係暫停一項長期回報不明顯的支出或投資，畀自己換個角度，再重新分配仍然有價值嘅資金。
wealth_rev_zh: 如果「暫停」變成無限拖延、投放沉沒成本或一直為鋪路而掏空自己，就會停曬喺原地；定低截止日期同復查條件，到期必須決定。
wealth_en: Letting go of an unproductive expense or investment can reveal a more valuable use for your money once you see the situation from a new angle.
wealth_rev_en: Do not let a supposed pause become endless delay or costly sacrifice; set a clear review date and make a firm decision when it arrives.
study_zh: 與其死衝，不如暫時放下書本，用唔同角度睇返個難題，停一停先會搵到豁然開朗嘅新方法。
study_rev_zh: 你卡住喺同一頁度拖延時間，又唔肯放手舊有理解，白白犧牲寶貴嘅溫習時間。
study_en: Pause the grind and let go of forcing; looking at the problem from a fresh angle invites an unexpected flash of clarity.
study_rev_en: You're stalled on the same page, resisting new approaches and clinging to old understanding, wasting precious time in useless sacrifice.
family_zh: 暫時擱置家庭計劃，換個角度睇問題，學習放手，等時機明朗。
family_rev_zh: 卡喺進退兩難，明知要變都唔肯放手，犧牲白費，拖延落去。
family_en: Pause family plans and look at problems from a new angle; surrender to timing and gain fresh perspective.
family_rev_en: Stalled between choices, refusing to let go; the sacrifice becomes wasted as indecision drags on.

mean_en: Endings, transformation, transition, release, renewal.
mean_rev_en: Resistance to endings, stagnation, fear of change, holding on, incomplete closure.
love_en: relationship transformation, ending a romantic chapter, emotional release, a new beginning after change
love_rev_en: resisting an ending, holding on, stagnation, incomplete closure
career_en: career transition, ending an outdated role, professional reinvention, making space for change
career_rev_en: clinging to an outdated role, fear of change, stagnation, delayed transition
mean_zh: 一個階段結束，讓該離開的離開；轉化之後，是更生機勃勃的你。
mean_rev_zh: 抗拒改變令一切停滯；放手讓舊的完結，新的才能進來。
love_zh: 舊關係模式的結束開啟新章，放手之後迎來更成熟的感情。
love_rev_zh: 抗拒結束只會延長痛苦，好好道別，才能騰出空間給新開始。
career_zh: 轉型與重組的時刻，舊崗位或舊方法落幕，新方向曙光初現。
career_rev_zh: 當心固守舊路陷入停滯，主動求變好過被環境逼着變。
health_zh: 身體經歷一次徹底轉化，好似舊細胞死亡後迎來新生，戒甩一個壞習慣就係最實際嘅療癒。

mean_zh: 衝突、競爭、摩擦、對立自我、分心。
mean_rev_zh: 避免衝突、解決問題、內在衝突、緊張放鬆、選擇戰鬥。
love_zh: 愛情緊張，爭議，爭取注意力的競爭，相沖的慾望
love_rev_zh: 避免爭議，未解決的緊張，內心爭議，選擇戰鬥
career_zh: 工作場所競爭，相沖的意見，專業競爭，生產性的挑戰
career_rev_zh: 避免爭議，放鬆緊張，內心競爭，解決在即
health_zh: 身體好似有五團火互相拉扯咁，例如肌肉發炎或壓力令免疫系統亂曬籠；與其亂試偏方，不如定一個清晰嘅運動計劃，將衝突變成鍛煉嘅動力。
health_rev_zh: 你已經開始避開令你緊張嘅活動，但內心對治療方案仍然好矛盾；試嚇寫低身體想休息嘅訊號，揀一項最溫和嘅運動重新開始，唔好逼自己同人比較。
health_en: Your body feels like five flames pulling in different directions—think muscle inflammation or stress scrambling your immune system; instead of jumping between remedies, commit to one clear exercise plan and turn inner friction into training fuel.
health_rev_en: You're dodging stressful activities but still torn about which treatment to trust; jot down your body's rest signals each night and restart with one gentle routine, without comparing yourself to anyone.
wealth_zh: 財路多人爭，唔好怕交手，競爭反而逼你搵到最Sharp嘅切入點，小注測試先落重注。
wealth_rev_zh: 避開正面衝突，暫時唔好同人鬥燒銀紙，停一停先識執返個錢罅。
wealth_en: Money doors get crowded, but treat rivalry as intel — outmanoeuvre them with a sharper angle and test before doubling down.
wealth_rev_en: Sidestep the bidding war; pulling back now stops a leaky portfolio from turning into a wreck.
study_zh: 溫書期間好多不同意見，同學之間競爭激烈，focus 要放喺自己進度而唔係同人鬥快。
study_rev_zh: 你終於避開無謂嘅比較，同組員化解分歧，揀返重要嘅課題嚟溫。
study_en: In study, clashing study styles and rivalries scatter your focus; channel the fire into a disciplined revision plan.
study_rev_en: You step back from unproductive competition, resolve clashes with classmates, and wisely prioritise the topics that matter for exams.
family_zh: 屋企人各有意見，好似廚房入面五個爐頭一齊煲嘢，火花四濺；不如約定飯後開個家庭會議，等大家講曬心底話。
family_rev_zh: 表面避開衝突，但屋企暗湧未停，個個忍氣吞聲；你要揀返真正值得爭嘅事，放下無謂嘅小事。
family_en: Family members are pulling in different directions like five boiling pots at once, so call a family meeting after dinner and let everyone air their true feelings.
family_rev_en: Conflict is being swept under the rug and silent tensions are building, so choose your battles wisely and let the small stuff go.

mean_en: Victory, recognition, success, confidence, public acclaim.
mean_rev_en: Private victory, fall from grace, self-doubt, lack of recognition, ego inflation.
love_en: romantic success, feeling admired, public recognition of a relationship, winning someone’s affection
love_rev_en: lack of recognition, self-doubt, private struggle, wounded pride
career_en: career recognition, promotion, public success, growing leadership credibility
career_rev_en: lack of recognition, fall from grace, self-doubt, ego inflation
mean_zh: 勝利、認可、成功、自信、公眾讚譽。
mean_rev_zh: 私人勝利、失敗、自我質疑、缺乏認可、自我膨脹。
love_zh: 愛情成功，感到被欣賞，關係的公眾認可，贏得某人的愛慕
love_rev_zh: 缺乏認可，自我質疑，私人奮鬥，受傷的傲慢
career_zh: 職業認可，晉升，公眾成功，領導力信譽增長
career_rev_zh: 缺乏認可，失敗，自我質疑，自我膨脹
health_zh: 身體終於俾返個勝利訊號你，例如驗身報告數字靚咗或者成功跑完目標裏數；記得將呢份成功感化成恆常習慣，唔好停喺一次嘅掌聲度。
health_rev_zh: 你可能已經有啲健康進步，但因為冇人留意就懷疑自己；唔好靠人哋認同，自己記錄低每日嘅小改變，畀身體應得嘅肯定。
health_en: Your body finally sends you a victory signal—like improved blood-test numbers or finishing that target distance; turn that sense of triumph into a daily habit rather than resting on one round of applause.
health_rev_en: You may already be making health gains but doubting yourself because no one notices; stop relying on outside approval and record your small wins each day to give your body the credit it deserves.
wealth_zh: 財運揚威，賺到錢之餘仲有人認同你嘅眼光，可以借勢擴大投資，但記得見好要收。
wealth_rev_zh: 贏咗都冇人知，或者個勢開始回落，唔好死撐面子，淨低嘅利潤要識收。
wealth_en: Wealth brings public wins and sharper reputation; ride the acclaim to scale up, yet keep a clear exit in mind.
wealth_rev_en: The glory fades or goes unnoticed; stop nursing your pride and bank the remaining gains before the tide turns.
study_zh: 測驗或考試有好成績，得到老師或同學公開認同，繼續保持呢個勢頭。
study_rev_zh: 就算未得到公開表揚，你其實已經暗中進步，唔好因為冇人讚而懷疑自己。
study_en: Recognition, maybe a high mark or public praise, crowns your hard work; use the win to consolidate your revision confidence.
study_rev_en: Success stays private or a slip in results shakes your self-belief; measure growth against your own past scores, not applause.
family_zh: 屋企有人升職、畢業或者獲獎，成家人一齊慶祝，仲可以藉呢次喜事修補冷戰咗嘅關係。
family_rev_zh: 你為頭家付出好多，但冇人多謝你，甚至覺得理所當然；唔好再等屋企人認同，先企出嚟肯定自己。
family_en: Someone in the family wins recognition, graduates or gets promoted, so gather everyone to celebrate and use the joy to mend a strained relationship.
family_rev_en: Your efforts for the family go unnoticed or feel taken for granted, so stop waiting for their approval and acknowledge your own worth first.

mean_en: Defense, standing your ground, perseverance, conviction, holding advantage.
mean_rev_en: Overwhelm, giving up ground, exhaustion, defensiveness, yielding.
love_en: defending a relationship, maintaining boundaries, fighting for love, resisting outside pressure
love_rev_en: overwhelm, giving up ground, defensiveness, exhaustion
career_en: defending your position, professional persistence, maintaining boundaries, standing your ground
career_rev_en: overwhelm, yielding position, exhaustion, defensiveness
mean_zh: 防禦、堅守立場、堅持、信念、保持優勢。
mean_rev_zh: 被壓倒、放棄立場、疲憊、防禦性、屈服。
love_zh: 保護關係，維持界限，爭取愛情，抵抗外部壓力
love_rev_zh: 不知所措，放棄地盤，防衛性，疲憊
career_zh: 保護你的位置，專業堅持，維持界限，堅持立場
career_rev_zh: 不知所措，放棄位置，疲憊，防衛性
health_zh: 依家係考驗你企穩立場嘅時候，例如拒絕朋友勸酒或者守住戒口嘅原則；同自己講『我嘅健康我話事』，每日堅持就係最佳防守。
health_rev_zh: 你已經攰到想放棄啲健康習慣，甚至覺得世界處處同你作對；不如放低『一定要贏』嘅心態，小休一日再砌過，容許自己求助。
health_en: Now is the time to hold your ground—refuse that glass your friend pushes or stick to your dietary rules; tell yourself 'my health, my call,' because daily persistence is the best defense.
health_rev_en: You're so exhausted you want to drop your healthy habits and feel like the world is against you; let go of the 'must-win' mindset, take one rest day, rebuild, and allow yourself to ask for help.
wealth_zh: 財富要守，企穩陣腳，唔好畀人哋搶咗你嘅市場份額，現金流就係你嘅護城河。
wealth_rev_zh: 守到喘唔到氣，可能迫到自己爆，俾自己鬆一鬆，諗下點樣放低冇效率嘅防線。
wealth_en: Wealth is a fortress: hold your position, protect market share, and let steady cash flow be the wall that guards you.
wealth_rev_en: You are exhausted from over-defending; release losing ground and costly defenses before burnout drains your reserves.
study_zh: 學業上要守住你嘅立場同成績，面對同學質疑或課程壓力都要企穩，堅持自己嘅溫書方法。
study_rev_zh: 你開始覺得捱唔住，想放棄某科或者被壓力壓垮，要識得退一步，唔好死頂。
study_en: Hold your academic ground: defend your thesis, your study schedule, and your viewpoint even when peers challenge you.
study_rev_en: You feel overwhelmed and may retreat from difficult material; pause, fortify your base, and choose battles worth fighting.
family_zh: 面對親戚閒言閒語或者外人插手你嘅家事，你要企硬，守住家庭嘅界線，唔好退讓半步。
family_rev_zh: 為家人撐得太攰，開始諗住放棄底線；但唔係每一場仗都要打，專注喺真正影響頭家嘅事就得。
family_en: In-laws are gossiping or outsiders are meddling in your family affairs, so stand firm and protect your household's boundaries without giving an inch.
family_rev_en: You are exhausted from defending the family and tempted to retreat, but not every battle matters—save your energy for what truly affects your home.

mean_en: Swift movement, momentum, news arriving, alignment, rapid progress.
mean_rev_en: Delays, frustration, scattered energy, missed timing, slowdown.
love_en: rapid romantic developments, passionate communication, unexpected messages, relationship momentum
love_rev_en: delays, miscommunication, missed timing, stalled momentum
career_en: rapid career developments, fast communication, work-related travel, accelerated progress
career_rev_en: delays, scattered energy, missed timing, frustration
mean_zh: 迅速移動、動力、新聞到來、對齊、快速進步。
mean_rev_zh: 延遲、挫折、能量分散、錯過時機、緩慢。
love_zh: 快速的愛情發展，激情溝通，意外的信息，關係動力
love_rev_zh: 延遲，溝通不暢，錯過時機，動力受阻
career_zh: 快速的職業發展，快速溝通，與工作相關的旅行，加速進步
career_rev_zh: 延遲，精力分散，錯過時機，挫折
health_zh: 康復速度快過你預期，好似身體嘅訊息突然暢通返，連約專科門診都有好消息；把握呢股動能，趁機執行新嘅作息同運動計劃。
health_rev_zh: 好似明明約好覆診又延期，病情進展停滯不前令人忟憎；與其亂咁催谷，不如學嚇慢呼吸，等身體同時間重新接軌。
health_en: Recovery is moving faster than expected—it's like the messages inside your body suddenly flow clearly and even specialist appointments bring good news; ride that momentum and launch your new sleep and exercise plan now.
health_rev_en: It feels like your follow-up appointment keeps getting delayed and progress has stalled, which is frustrating; instead of forcing things, practise slow breathing and let your body reconnect with time.
wealth_zh: 錢銀消息飛到，交易要快狠準，個勢似火箭，把握一週內嘅黃金時間落實計劃。
wealth_rev_zh: 入數延遲、合約卡關，唔好躁，未到嘅錢當未係你，順勢調整時間表。
wealth_en: Wealth accelerates with lightning deals and fast-moving news; strike within the next week while momentum is hot.
wealth_rev_en: Payments and contracts stall; resist the urge to force it, treat pending money as not yours, and reset your timeline.
study_zh: 溫書進度突然加快，好多新資訊同測驗通知湧到，把握速度完成手上嘅練習。
study_rev_zh: 計劃無曬速度，deadline 延誤或者你左拖右拖，要即刻固定時間表，清除分心嘢。
study_en: Fast momentum sweeps you through assignments and study topics; answer incoming questions and ride the wave to quick progress.
study_rev_en: Delays and mixed-up timetables stall you; stop rushing, reset your schedule, and address what is blocking the flow.
family_zh: 屋企突然傳來好消息，例如搬屋、添丁或者家人返嚟團聚，節奏快到你哋要即刻行動執嘢。
family_rev_zh: 家庭計劃一再延遲，訊息來來回回都冇結果；與其催人，不如利用呢段時間執好細節，準備隨時起行。
family_en: Sudden good news hits the family—a move, a new baby, or a relative returning home—so move fast and start packing or planning right away.
family_rev_en: Family plans keep stalling and messages go back and forth with no result, so stop rushing others and use this delay to fine-tune the details.

mean_en: Resilience, last stand, persistence, guardedness, nearly there.
mean_rev_en: Burnout, paranoia, giving up at the end, rigid defenses, battle fatigue.
love_en: emotional guardedness, relationship resilience, cautious trust, protecting the heart
love_rev_en: battle fatigue, rigid defenses, paranoia, giving up near the end
career_en: professional resilience, cautious persistence, nearing completion, protecting previous gains
career_rev_en: burnout, rigid defensiveness, giving up at the end, exhaustion
mean_zh: 彈性、最後的抵抗、堅持、謹慎、即將完成。
mean_rev_zh: 疲憊、偏執、最後放棄、僵化的防禦、戰鬥疲憊。
love_zh: 情感防禦，關係彈性，謹慎的信任，保護心靈
love_rev_zh: 戰鬥疲憊，堅硬的防禦，偏執狂，最後放棄
career_zh: 專業彈性，謹慎的堅持，接近完成，保護既得利益
career_rev_zh: 燃燒殆盡，堅硬的防禦，最後放棄，疲憊
health_zh: 你已經捱到最後一公里，例如療程只淨返最後一次，但身體仍然要保住防線；唔好鬆懈，但都唔使驚，畀自己見證埋呢個尾段。
health_rev_zh: 長期抗病搞到你身心俱疲，開始疑神疑鬼，覺得乜嘢都令病情惡化；試嚇放鬆啲戒備，將『全面防範』改為『日日有進步』，畀身體透嚇氣。
health_en: You've made it to the final mile—say, the last session of your treatment—but your body still needs to keep its guard up; don't let go of discipline, yet don't panic either, and let yourself witness this last stretch.
health_rev_en: Long-term illness has drained you physically and mentally, making you paranoid that everything worsens your condition; loosen those rigid defences by shifting from 'total prevention' to 'progress every day' and give your body room to breathe.
wealth_zh: 財路好似捱到最後一關，之前損傷未復原，但再頂多一步就有回報，唔好斷供。
wealth_rev_zh: 錢債壓力大到想放棄，其實已近終點，唔好喺最後一刻縮沙，先處理自己嘅疲勞。
wealth_en: Wealth is a last stand after heavy losses; hold the line one more stretch and the payoff lies just beyond your fatigue.
wealth_rev_en: Burnout tempts you to abandon ship near the finish; reset your energy first, then take the final short step to recover.
study_zh: 你已經喺學期尾擦緊鬚，仲有最後一科，要頂住疲勞，守住之前溫曬嘅內容。
study_rev_zh: 長期開夜車搞到 burnout，仲有少少疑神疑鬼，覺得自己乜都唔記得；最後階段要適量休息先頂得完。
study_en: You are almost through the exam season; protect the knowledge you have gained and refuse to give up in the final stretch.
study_rev_en: Exhaustion and self-doubt mount at the last step; stop grinding and include rest—your brain will consolidate and still remember.
family_zh: 你已經為頭家撐到最後一關，雖然攰到想瞓低，但仲未可以鬆懈；同屋企人講清楚你需要支援。
family_rev_zh: 家庭責任令你burnout，仲開始疑神疑鬼覺得冇人幫手；學識拆低道牆，接受屋企人遞過嚟嘅好意。
family_en: You are at the last stand for your family, exhausted but unable to relax yet, so tell your loved ones exactly what kind of support you need.
family_rev_en: Family duties have burned you out and you are becoming paranoid that nobody helps, so lower your defences and actually accept the care they offer.

mean_en: Burden, overload, responsibility, carrying too much, final effort.
mean_rev_en: Release, delegation, putting burdens down, collapse, learning to say no.
love_en: relationship burdens, emotional pressure, carrying too much responsibility, love feeling demanding
love_rev_en: releasing burdens, collapse under pressure, learning to say no, delegating
career_en: overwork, excessive responsibility, burnout risk, need to delegate
career_rev_en: putting burdens down, delegation, collapse, learning to say no
mean_zh: 負擔、過載、責任、攜帶過多、最後努力。
mean_rev_zh: 釋放、委派、放下負擔、崩潰、學會說不。
love_zh: 關係負擔，情感壓力，承擔太多責任，愛情感到要求苛刻
love_rev_zh: 放棄負擔，在壓力下崩潰，學會說不，委派
career_zh: 過度工作，過多的責任，燃燒的風險，需要委派
career_rev_zh: 放下負擔，委派，崩潰，學會說不
health_zh: 成副擔子都壓喺個身度，例如又要返工又要照顧屋企，搞到肩頸痛、失眠齊齊嚟；要認清自己唔係超人，即刻減走一項非必要嘅責任。
health_rev_zh: 身體終於頂唔順爆煲，逼你放下手上所有嘢；趁呢次機會學識拒絕，將家務或者工作分配出去，唔好再攬曬上身。
health_en: All the weight is on your shoulders—work, family, everything—and it shows up as neck pain and insomnia; admit you're not superhuman and cut one non-essential responsibility immediately.
health_rev_en: Your body has finally crashed and forces you to drop everything; use this moment to learn to say no, delegate chores or work tasks, and stop carrying it all alone.
wealth_zh: 攬住太多財務責任，個袋重到就嚟爆，賺到都唔夠交數，要重新分配先有運行。
wealth_rev_zh: 終於肯放下，畀人幫手或掟走蝕本項目，鬆綁之後先可以真正儲到錢。
wealth_en: Wealth feels like an overloaded cart: you carry debt and duties, so restructure the load before the returns crush you.
wealth_rev_en: Release and delegate the weight; cut the losing ventures and share the burden, then saving actually becomes possible.
study_zh: 背住過多功課同科目，成績被擔子拖到落嚟，要清楚自己唔可以一腳踢。
study_rev_zh: 你會學識放手同分派工作，唔再死攬所有責任，揀返最重要嘅學業目標去減壓。
study_en: Overloaded coursework and unrealistic expectations crush your performance; you carry a heavy study load that needs systematic pruning.
study_rev_en: You finally release impossible burdens—delegate group work, drop perfectionism, and separate essential study goals from optional extras.
family_zh: 你一個人孭起成頭家嘅責任，做到就快透唔到氣；即刻將家務、財務同照顧工作分擔畀其他成員。
family_rev_zh: 你終於肯放手，將重擔交畀家人分擔，甚至搬出去或者減少照顧責任；學識講「唔得閒」，唔使攬曬上身。
family_en: You are carrying the entire household's burdens and can barely breathe, so immediately delegate chores, finances and caregiving to other family members.
family_rev_en: You are finally putting the burden down and letting relatives share the load, or moving away and cutting responsibilities, so practice saying 'I'm not available.'

mean_en: Enthusiasm, exploration, free spirit, exciting news, curiosity.
mean_rev_en: Scattered energy, hasty starts, boredom, unreliable news, restlessness.
love_en: flirtation, exciting messages, playful attraction, curiosity about a new romance
love_rev_en: scattered interest, boredom, unreliable messages, restlessness
career_en: career curiosity, exciting opportunity, learning through action, creative professional news
career_rev_en: hasty starts, boredom, unreliable news, scattered focus
mean_zh: 熱情、探索、自由精神、新聞、好奇心。
mean_rev_zh: 能量分散、急於開始、無聊、不可靠的新聞、焦慮。
love_zh: 調情，興奮的信息，遊戲性的吸引，對新愛情的好奇心
love_rev_zh: 興趣分散，無聊，不可靠的信息，焦慮不安
career_zh: 職業好奇心，興奮的機會，通過行動學習，創意專業新聞
career_rev_zh: 急於開始，無聊，不可靠的新聞，注意力分散
health_zh: 對健康嘅好奇心跳返出嚟，例如想試瑜伽、冥想或者新嘅跑步路線；大膽開始，但記住由初階入手，享受探索過程。
health_rev_zh: 你成日三分鐘熱度，今日試呢個食譜聽日又轉另一套；與其追新潮流，不如揀一樣做夠三十日，先睇真個效果。
health_en: Your curiosity about health is sparking again—maybe you want to try yoga, meditation, or a new running route; start boldly but keep it beginner-level, and enjoy the exploration itself.
health_rev_en: You keep starting things with three-minute passion, switching recipes today and programs tomorrow; instead of chasing trends, choose one practice and stick to it for thirty days before judging the results.
wealth_zh: 有條新財路燃起你好奇心，細額試水、跟住直覺去學，有機會變真財。
wealth_rev_zh: 一時衝動入市，消息得個信字，計劃未落實就唔好加註，停一停先。
wealth_en: A spark of financial curiosity opens a fresh income stream; explore it with a small stake and let learning fuel the fire.
wealth_rev_en: Hasty bets land on unverified rumours; don’t add funds until the plan is concrete, slow down and verify first.
study_zh: 對新課題充滿好奇，想試新嘅溫書方法或課外進修，趁熱情未退快啲開始。
study_rev_zh: 一時衝動開始好多新計劃但無樣做得成，或者收到未確認嘅升學消息；等情報確定先行動。
study_en: Curious and energised, you dive into a new subject or creative project for school; explore while your enthusiasm is fresh.
study_rev_en: You scatter energy across half-finished ideas or act on unreliable academic news; slow down and verify before committing.
family_zh: 屋企有後輩或者你自己對新事物好有興趣，提議一齊學煮餸、拍片或者種植物，為家庭注入返活力。
family_rev_zh: 家庭入面嘅新計劃得三分鐘熱度，訊息講完就冇下文；唔好亂開空頭支票，揀一樣嘢專注完成佢。
family_en: A younger family member or you is bursting with curiosity, so suggest learning a new skill together—cooking, filming or planting—to energise the household.
family_rev_en: A family project fizzles out after a few days and promises go nowhere, so stop making empty commitments and focus on completing one thing properly.

mean_en: Action, adventure, passion, bold pursuit, charisma.
mean_rev_en: Impulsiveness, recklessness, scattered passion, delays in action, hot temper.
love_en: passionate pursuit, intense chemistry, impulsive romance, an exciting but inconsistent lover
love_rev_en: impulsive romance, hot and cold, recklessness, scattered passion
career_en: ambitious action, bold career change, entrepreneurial drive, impulsive professional decisions
career_rev_en: impulsive decisions, recklessness, delays in action, hot temper
mean_zh: 行動、冒險、熱情、果敢追求、魅力。
mean_rev_zh: 衝動、冒險、熱情分散、行動延遲、火爆。
love_zh: 激情追求，強烈的化學作用，衝動的愛情，令人興奮但不一貫的情人
love_rev_zh: 衝動的愛情，熱冷無常，險險為功，激情分散
career_zh: 野心勃勃的行動，勇敢的職業變革，企業家驅動，衝動的專業決策
career_rev_zh: 衝動的決策，險險為功，行動延遲，火爆脾氣
health_zh: 你有一股衝勁想即刻同身體並肩作戰，例如報名參加越野賽或高強度間歇訓練；行動係好，但要量力而為，先熱身先保護關節。
health_rev_zh: 太心急想做多啲，結果可能拉傷肌肉或者練過頭；停一停，將訓練量減半，用穩定節奏取代盲目衝刺。
health_en: You're fired up to charge into battle with your body—maybe by signing up for a trail race or HIIT sessions; action is great, but pace yourself, warm up properly, and protect your joints.
health_rev_en: Rushing too hard can easily pull a muscle or lead to overtraining; pause, cut your training volume in half, and replace blind sprints with a steady rhythm.
wealth_zh: 財富要用行動去追，夠膽推自己一把，快市場半步，錢就會跟你走。
wealth_rev_zh: 衝得太快變曬賭博，唔好再追加註碼，剎一剎車，等個心定返先衡量風險。
wealth_en: Wealth favours bold pursuit: act ahead of the market, own the risk, and your momentum will drag money along.
wealth_rev_en: Reckless speed has turned investing into gambling; stop adding fuel, brake hard, and reassess every risk before moving.
study_zh: 為咗目標科系或比賽全速前進，行動力好強，但都要節制住唔好三分鐘熱度。
study_rev_zh: 淨係得個衝字，好快衝動轉科或報讀唔啱嘅課程，仲可能因為冇耐性而失分。
study_en: A bold, passionate push powers your study—attack challenging assignments with confidence and visible momentum.
study_rev_en: Rash decisions and a wandering focus sabotage your work; pause your impulsiveness, build a realistic study routine, and follow through.
family_zh: 你帶頭搞家庭旅行或者裝修，憑住一股衝勁帶動成家人一齊行動；不過行動之前記得先開會商量。
family_rev_zh: 屋企決定太衝動，可能因為一時火氣就話要搬出去或者搞大計劃；停一停，諗清楚後果先再鬱手。
family_en: You are leading a family trip or renovation with fiery passion and sweeping everyone along, but still hold a proper discussion before you charge forward.
family_rev_en: A family decision is dangerously impulsive, like moving out or starting a big plan in a fit of temper, so pause and count the consequences first.

mean_en: Confidence, warmth, determination, magnetism, independence.
mean_rev_en: Insecurity, jealousy, demanding nature, burnout, dimmed confidence.
love_en: confidence in love, magnetic attraction, warmth and passion, independent partnership
love_rev_en: insecurity, jealousy, demanding energy, dimmed confidence
career_en: career confidence, creative leadership, professional charisma, independent success
career_rev_en: insecurity, burnout, jealousy, dimmed confidence
mean_zh: 自信、溫暖、決心、吸引力、獨立。
mean_rev_zh: 不安全感、嫉妒、要求性、疲憊、自信降低。
love_zh: 對愛情的自信，磁性的吸引，溫暖和激情，獨立伴侶關係
love_rev_zh: 不安全感，嫉妒，要求能量，信心減弱
career_zh: 職業自信，創意領導，專業魅力，獨立成功
career_rev_zh: 不安全感，燃燒殆盡，嫉妒，信心減弱
health_zh: 對自己嘅身體多返一分自信同暖意，例如煮餐好餸畀自己食，或者照鏡時讚嚇自己；呢種自愛就係最強嘅免疫力。
health_rev_zh: 你可能成日同人比較身形，搞到冇曬心機，仲忽略咗基本休息；停止羨慕人，由每日飲夠水、瞓夠覺開始重建自信。
health_en: Regain warmth and confidence in your own body—cook yourself a nourishing meal or say something kind when you look in the mirror; this self-love is the strongest immunity you can build.
health_rev_en: You may be constantly comparing your shape to others, losing motivation and even skipping basic rest; stop envying people and rebuild confidence by starting with enough water and enough sleep each day.
wealth_zh: 你嘅自信就係生財工具，企出嚟，錢會自然埋嚟，適合帶住團隊傾大刁。
wealth_rev_zh: 冇曬火，開始嫉妒人哋搵錢快，唔好鬥氣使錢，返去確認自己價值先。
wealth_en: Your magnetic confidence is the money magnet; step forward and pitch big, prosperity follows your presence.
wealth_rev_en: Dulled self-belief makes you envy others’ gains; don’t spend in spite, realign with your own value first.
study_zh: 你主導自己嘅學習，用自信同熱情吸引學習夥伴，遇到難題都保持正面心態。
study_rev_zh: 比較心令你自信跌落，可能因為某科表現唔理想就鑽牛角尖，要記得你本身嘅能力仲喺度。
study_en: You take confident ownership of your studies: lead the group discussion, speak up in class, and make progress from inner conviction.
study_rev_en: A dip in self-confidence or envy of high-achieving classmates dims your spark; reconnect with the strengths you already showed before.
family_zh: 你係屋企嘅溫暖中心，自信又有魅力，煮餐飯或一句問候就令成個家凝聚起嚟，繼續帶動正面氣氛。
family_rev_zh: 你喺屋企覺得唔被重視，開始嫉妒其他成員，或者覺得自己燃燒殆盡；先離開嚇現場，重新搵返自己嘅價值。
family_en: You are the warm heart of the home, radiating confidence and charm—cook a meal or send a caring message and the whole family will gather around you again.
family_rev_en: You feel unappreciated at home and jealousy or burnout is creeping in, so step away from the scene for a bit and rebuild your sense of self-worth.

mean_en: Visionary leadership, boldness, entrepreneurship, mastery of fire, inspiration.
mean_rev_en: Arrogance, tyranny, impulsive leadership, unfulfilled vision, domineering.
love_en: bold romantic leadership, passionate commitment, protective affection, pursuing love with confidence
love_rev_en: domineering, impulsive, arrogance, unfulfilled promises
career_en: visionary leadership, business growth, decisive action, inspiring others
career_rev_en: arrogance, impulsive leadership, tyranny, unrealized vision
mean_zh: 遠見領導、果敢、創業精神、火之掌控、啟發。
mean_rev_zh: 傲慢、專制、衝動領導、未實現的視野、專橫。
love_zh: 果斷的愛情領導，激情承諾，保護的愛情，自信地追求愛情
love_rev_zh: 專橫，衝動，傲慢，未實現的承諾
career_zh: 先見之明領導，業務增長，決定性行動，鼓勵他人
career_rev_zh: 傲慢，衝動的領導，專橫，未實現的願景
health_zh: 你要做自己健康嘅CEO，例如訂立一個半年目標，安排運動、飲食同休息時間表；用你嘅魄力帶動成家人一齊行。
health_rev_zh: 你或者太自信，連醫生嘅建議都唔聽，仲用『頂得住』嚟自欺；學嚇謙虛，將宏大嘅養生大計拆細成每日做到嘅小任務。
health_en: Become the CEO of your own health—set a six-month goal and schedule exercise, meals, and rest; use your charisma to inspire your whole family to move with you.
health_rev_en: You may be so overconfident that you ignore medical advice and fool yourself with 'I can handle it'; stay humble and break that grand wellness plan into tiny daily tasks you can actually finish.
wealth_zh: 財富要由你話事，目光放遠，敢使錢去放大個版圖，老闆命格，錢要為你效率服務。
wealth_rev_zh: 獨裁式理財，以為自己一定啱，容易一注輸清，聽人勸，降低槓桿。
wealth_en: Wealth answers visionary command: set a grand game plan, invest boldly in scale, and make money work for your empire.
wealth_rev_en: Arrogant money control blinds you; one oversized bet can wipe the board. Listen, cut leverage, and share decisions.
study_zh: 你有能力制定長遠學習計劃，仲可以帶領小組做 project，將願景變成實際行動。
study_rev_zh: 固執己見或唔聽人講，又可能離唔開空想，計劃太忟，要將大圖畫拆細先可行。
study_en: Assume authority over your academic vision: set ambitious goals, motivate study partners, and lead a project to completion.
study_rev_en: Overconfidence or a domineering study style alienates help from others; downscale your grand plan and collaborate humbly.
family_zh: 你係屋企嘅領軍人物，有遠見亦有執行力，可以帶領家庭實踐一個宏大目標，例如買樓、創業或者全家移居。
family_rev_zh: 喺屋企太霸道，家人覺得你獨裁，計劃亦可能得個講字；要學習聆聽眾人意見，唔好淨係叫人跟住你做。
family_en: You are the visionary leader of the family, combining bold ideas with execution, so rally everyone behind a big goal like buying a home, starting a business or relocating.
family_rev_en: You are being domineering at home and the family sees you as a tyrant, so your grand plans remain empty words—start listening instead of demanding obedience.

mean_en: New love, emotional beginning, compassion, overflowing heart, spiritual opening.
mean_rev_en: Blocked emotions, emptiness, repressed feelings, emotional loss, self-love needed.
love_en: new love, emotional opening, overflowing affection, deepening feelings
love_rev_en: blocked emotions, repressed feelings, emotional loss, needing self-love
career_en: fulfilling opportunity, creative inspiration, emotionally rewarding work, positive workplace beginning
career_rev_en: unfulfilling opportunity, emotional emptiness at work, blocked inspiration, missed connection
mean_zh: 新愛情、情感開始、慈悲、心滿滿、靈性開啟。
mean_rev_zh: 情感阻塞、空虛、壓抑情感、情感失落、需要自愛。
love_zh: 新愛情，情感開放，滿溢的愛情，感情加深
love_rev_zh: 受阻的情感，壓抑的情感，情感失落，需要自我愛
career_zh: 滿足的機會，創意啟發，情感上獲益的工作，積極的工作開始
career_rev_zh: 不滿足的機會，工作中的情感空白，受阻的啟發，錯過連結
health_zh: 心口好似有股暖流湧出嚟，代表情緒開始得到療癒；試嚇每日做感恩練習或者同信任嘅人傾訴，將鬱結釋放，身體自然輕返。
health_rev_zh: 情緒好似塞住咗，對咩都提唔起勁，甚至令心口悶痛；唔好再壓抑自己，容許喊一場或者寫低感受，重新學習錫自己。
health_en: A warm current seems to rise from your chest, signalling the start of emotional healing; try a daily gratitude practice or confide in someone you trust, and as the knots loosen, your body will feel lighter.
health_rev_en: Your emotions feel blocked, leaving you apathetic and even causing tightness in your chest; stop repressing yourself—allow a good cry or write down your feelings, and relearn how to cherish yourself.
wealth_zh: 錢財由心出發，慳唔係靠死𢯊，搵到真正想做嘅事，財源自然滿瀉。
wealth_rev_zh: 心中有個窿，錢幾多都唔安心，先療癒自己，否則只會用購物麻醉空虛。
wealth_en: Wealth flows from emotional abundance: follow genuine passion and the money fills the cup without force.
wealth_rev_en: An inner lack makes money unsatisfying; heal the emptiness first or spending becomes a hollow anaesthetic.
study_zh: 對學習重新燃起熱情，或者喺某個題目上突然打通，情感上願意投入更深去理解。
study_rev_zh: 學習動力閉塞，覺得冇意思或者壓抑住挫敗感；先處理好情緒，再諗溫書方法。
study_en: A fresh emotional connection to learning opens—creative inspiration, a new subject, or genuine joy in understanding.
study_rev_en: Study feels empty or emotionally blocked, maybe from stress or disappointment; restore your motivation by starting small and affirming your effort.
family_zh: 家庭關係出現新嘅情感契機，例如修補裂痕、迎接新成員或者終於講出口嘅心底話，愛意由心而發。
family_rev_zh: 屋企人情感封閉，或者你壓抑緊對家人嘅感受，覺得空虛；先好好愛自己，照顧返自己嘅情緒，先有能力打開心扉。
family_en: A new emotional beginning emerges at home—a rift heals, a baby arrives, or feelings are finally spoken aloud—so let love flow from your open heart.
family_rev_en: Emotions are blocked at home and you feel empty or suppressed around family, so practise self-love first before you can open your heart to them again.

mean_en: Partnership, mutual attraction, connection, harmony, union of equals.
mean_rev_en: Imbalance, broken connection, tension, miscommunication, self-partnership needed.
love_en: mutual love, emotional partnership, shared attraction, balanced connection
love_rev_en: imbalance, broken connection, tension, miscommunication
career_en: successful partnership, strong collaboration, professional agreement, shared career goals
career_rev_en: broken partnership, tension, misaligned goals, poor collaboration
mean_zh: 伴侶關係、相互吸引、連接、和諧、平等聯姻。
mean_rev_zh: 不平衡、關係破裂、緊張、溝通不良、需要自我伴侶。
love_zh: 雙方的愛情，情感夥伴關係，共享吸引，平衡的連結
love_rev_zh: 不平衡，破裂的連結，緊張，溝通不暢
career_zh: 成功的夥伴關係，強大的合作，專業協議，共享職業目標
career_rev_zh: 破裂的夥伴關係，緊張，目標不對齊，合作不佳
health_zh: 你同自己嘅身體終於傾到數，例如好自然就揀咗健康餐，又會乖乖早瞓；呢份內在默契就係最佳保健良方，繼續同身體拍住拖一齊行。
health_rev_zh: 你同自己嘅身體斷咗聯繫，例如過勞都唔知，肚餓先食一餐；坐低兩分鐘，問嚇個身最想點，重新建立呢段夥伴關係。
health_en: You and your body are finally on the same page—you naturally choose a healthy meal and go to bed early without a fight; this inner partnership is the best wellness prescription, so keep walking hand in hand with your body.
health_rev_en: You've lost connection with your body—not noticing exhaustion, eating only when starving; sit quietly for two minutes, ask your body what it really needs, and rebuild that partnership.
wealth_zh: 財富要靠拍檔，傾掂數、簽好約，兩人互補，錢就匯成一股力。
wealth_rev_zh: 夾錢關係失去平衡，有單大嘅數未傾清楚，暫時唔好再擴充，先理順關係。
wealth_en: Wealth grows through equal partnership: align goals, sign the agreement, and mutual strengths double your capital.
wealth_rev_en: A money partnership tilts off-balance; postpone expansion and talk the big figures through before funding more.
study_zh: 同同學配對溫書互相補足，兩人嘅知識互補，形成有效嘅學習夥伴關係。
study_rev_zh: 小組合作出現不平衡，或者同學習夥伴溝通唔到，同自己先和解，揀個可靠嘅夥伴再出發。
study_en: A study partnership clicks: share notes, debate ideas, and hold each other accountable to exam goals.
study_rev_en: Miscommunication or uneven effort breaks a study duo; reassess expectations and build a balanced support system—or become your own best accountability partner.
family_zh: 家庭成員之間達成真正嘅平等合作，例如夫妻拍住上處理家事，或者兄弟姊妹夾錢供養父母，關係和諧。
family_rev_zh: 屋企關係失去平衡，溝通錯位，可能夫妻或兄弟姊妹正在冷戰；先同自己和解，再坐低好好傾返場。
family_en: Two family members become true partners, like spouses sharing household duties or siblings pooling money to support parents, creating genuine harmony.
family_rev_en: Your home relationship is off balance with miscommunication or a silent cold war, so make peace with yourself first and then sit down for an honest talk.

mean_en: Celebration, friendship, community, joy shared, creative collaboration.
mean_rev_en: Overindulgence, third-party interference, isolation from friends, gossip, excess.
love_en: dating and socializing, joyful reunion, celebration with a partner, friendship becoming romantic
love_rev_en: third-party interference, isolation, gossip, overindulgence
career_en: teamwork, professional networking, workplace celebration, supportive colleagues
career_rev_en: isolation from the team, gossip, overindulgence, workplace cliques
mean_zh: 慶祝、友誼、社區、共享快樂、創意合作。
mean_rev_zh: 過度沉溺、第三者介入、與朋友疏遠、流言蜚語、過度。
love_zh: 約會和社交，愉快的重逢，與夥伴慶祝，友誼變得浪漫
love_rev_zh: 第三者幹擾，孤立，流言蜚語，過度沉溺
career_zh: 團隊合作，專業網絡，工作場所慶祝，支持性的同事
career_rev_zh: 與團隊孤立，流言蜚語，過度沉溺，工作場所小圈子
health_zh: 健康路上唔使孤單，約朋友一齊行山、報團做運動，完成目標再慶祝一餐；有同伴互相督促，好快見到成果。
health_rev_zh: 身邊嘅聚會可能變成放縱藉口，例如飲酒食油膩嘢一發不可收拾，或者朋友阻礙你戒口；要企穩自己嘅尺度，必要時遠離應酬，保護健康進度。
health_en: You don't have to walk the health path alone—invite friends hiking, join a group workout class, and celebrate together once you hit a goal; with companions spurring each other on, results come quickly.
health_rev_en: Social gatherings may become excuses for indulgence, like drinking and greasy food spiralling out of control, or friends undermining your dietary discipline; stand firm on your boundaries and step away from unnecessary banquets to protect your progress.
wealth_zh: 財運靠人氣帶動，朋友介紹、團隊分紅，開支要開心，錢先流得順。
wealth_rev_zh: 聚會散財，或朋友之間因錢而尷介，少啲應酬、遠離是非圈，錢包即刻止血。
wealth_en: Wealth thrives with community: referral deals, team bonuses and shared wins keep money circulating joyfully.
wealth_rev_en: Social spending drains your wallet and money becomes awkward among friends; cut the gossip circles and stop the bleed.
study_zh: 同成班同學一齊溫書、交流筆記同加油打氣，羣體學習令你動力大增。
study_rev_zh: 學習焦點被社交活動搶走，或者有是非影響團隊氣氛；要識得分開玩樂同溫書時間。
study_en: Group revision and class camaraderie energise your study: share insights, celebrate small wins, and learn together for better morale.
study_rev_en: Socialising, gossip, or a disruptive clique pulls you away from the books; set boundaries and separate fun time from revision time.
family_zh: 一家人齊齊整整慶祝節日，朋友亦好似家人咁聚埋一齊，喜悅滿瀉，值得開支酒乾杯。
family_rev_zh: 家庭聚會有第三者搞事或者講是非，可能飲大兩杯就爆衝突；要設立清晰界線，畀自己遠離是非圈。
family_en: The whole family gathers to celebrate and close friends join in like kin, so pour a drink and toast—the joy is overflowing and meant to be shared.
family_rev_en: A third party stirs up trouble or gossip at a family gathering, and too much drink may spark a scene, so set clear boundaries and step away from the drama.

mean_en: Apathy, contemplation, disconnection, missed offer, reevaluation.
mean_rev_en: Renewed interest, accepting the offer, emerging from withdrawal, new motivation, openness.
love_en: emotional withdrawal, romantic dissatisfaction, overlooking an opportunity, feeling disconnected
love_rev_en: renewed interest, accepting an offer, emerging from withdrawal, openness
career_en: career dissatisfaction, workplace boredom, overlooked opportunity, need for renewed motivation
career_rev_en: renewed motivation, accepting an opportunity, re-engagement, fresh interest
mean_zh: 冷漠、沉思、斷絕連接、錯過機會、重新評估。
mean_rev_zh: 重新興趣、接受機會、從抽離中走出、新動機、開放。
love_zh: 情感抽離，愛情不滿足，忽視機會，感到疏遠
love_rev_zh: 重燃興趣，接受提議，從抽離中走出，開放
career_zh: 職業不滿足，工作場所無聊，忽視機會，需要新的動力
career_rev_zh: 新的動力，接受機會，重新參與，新興興趣
health_zh: 對身體嘅倦怠訊號視而不見，好似對住眼前杯水都唔想攞起，提示你要靜落嚟重新審視自己嘅健康習慣。
health_rev_zh: 終於肯正視身體嘅求救，開始接受治療或改變生活節奏，從麻木中行出嚟，對健康重拾主動。
health_en: You're ignoring your body's fatigue signals like a full cup you refuse to pick up; pause and reassess your daily health habits.
health_rev_en: You finally face your body's SOS, accept help or change your routine, and step out of apathy with renewed energy for self-care.
wealth_zh: 你對目前財務狀況感到厭倦，坐喺度睇住銀行結餘發呆，忽略咗一個送到面前嘅賺錢機會。要停低抱怨，審視自己係咪因為悶而錯過咗某個 offer。
wealth_rev_zh: 你重新對理財產生興趣，願意接受之前拒絕嘅投資或工作機會，從封閉狀態走出嚟，開始主動搵錢。
wealth_en: You're bored with your current finances, staring at a stagnant bank balance while ignoring a real money-making opportunity that's been offered to you. Write down one overlooked income source and take action.
wealth_rev_en: You're finally regaining interest in managing money, ready to accept a previously rejected investment or job offer. Break out of your withdrawal and start actively rebuilding your wealth.
study_zh: 對住書本提唔起勁，覺得課程好悶，可能錯過咗一個對學業有幫助嘅機會，係時候重新審視自己嘅學習方向。
study_rev_zh: 重新對學習產生興趣，接受之前忽略咗嘅學習機會，走出溫習嘅厭倦狀態，重新有動力返去書枱。
study_en: You feel bored and disconnected from your books, and in that haze you may miss a real opportunity—so sit back and actively review which study chances you have overlooked.
study_rev_en: You are snapping out of study apathy, accepting the help or opportunity you previously ignored, and starting with fresh motivation to reopen your revision plan.
family_zh: 屋企人各自低頭，明明有人關心都當睇唔到，係時候重新審視點樣打開心窗。
family_rev_zh: 有人開始主動回應家人嘅關心，願意參與家庭聚會，走出冷戰嘅角落。
family_en: A family member sits silently at the dinner table, missing the quiet offer of connection—pause and reflect before the warmth fades.
family_rev_en: Someone finally puts down their guard, accepts a relative's invitation, and steps back into the family circle with fresh energy.

mean_en: Loss, grief, regret, focusing on what's gone, disappointment.
mean_rev_en: Acceptance, moving on, forgiveness, seeing what remains, healing.
love_en: heartbreak, regret in love, grieving a relationship, focusing on emotional loss
love_rev_en: acceptance, moving on, forgiveness, healing
career_en: professional disappointment, missed opportunity, career regret, learning from setbacks
career_rev_en: moving on from setbacks, acceptance, learning from loss, recovery
mean_zh: 損失、傷痛、悔恨、專注於已失去的事物、失望。
mean_rev_zh: 接受、繼續前行、寬恕、看到所留下的事物、癒合。
love_zh: 心碎，愛情中的悔恨，哀悼一段關係，著重於情感上的失落
love_rev_zh: 接受，繼續前行，原諒，療傷
career_zh: 職業失望，錯過機會，職業悔恨，從失敗中學習
career_rev_zh: 從失敗中走出，接受，從失敗中學習，恢復
health_zh: 病痛或體能下降令你只望住打翻嘅三隻杯，沉溺喺「以前好地地」嘅遺憾入面，忘記仲有兩隻杯企喺度。
health_rev_zh: 接受身體而家嘅狀況，放低對舊時健康嘅執著，將焦點轉去仲有能力做嘅事，先真正開始復原。
health_en: Illness or lost fitness makes you stare at the spilled cups, grieving how healthy you used to be while ignoring the two cups still standing.
health_rev_en: You accept your body's current limits, release regret about past health, and focus on what you can still do—that's when real healing begins.
wealth_zh: 喺財富上，你聚焦喺損失度，例如股票蝕咗、投資失利，眼淚遮住咗其他仍然存在嘅資產。要寫低你仲擁有嘅資源，唔好淨係望住個空杯。
wealth_rev_zh: 你開始接受損失，放手過去，原諒自己嘅決策錯誤，將注意力轉去仲有嘅錢同機會，重新出發。
wealth_en: In wealth matters, you're fixated on what you lost—a failed stock, a bad deal—and your grief blinds you to the assets you still hold. Make a list of what remains and use it as your starting point.
wealth_rev_en: You're accepting the financial loss, forgiving your past decisions, and turning your attention to the money and opportunities still present. Healing allows you to move forward with a clearer budget.
study_zh: 考試失利或成績未如理想，沉溺喺分數嘅失落入面，成日諗返失敗，但其實仲有未考嘅科目同可以挽救嘅分數。
study_rev_zh: 接受咗個結果，原諒自己之前嘅表現，放低失敗，專注返仲有嘅機會同實際可以點補救溫習計劃。
study_en: A disappointing result or failed subject makes you focus only on what you lost, so you keep replaying the mistake instead of counting the chapters and exams you can still save.
study_rev_en: You accept the setback, forgive your past performance, and turn your attention to the remaining study material and the recovery strategies you can actually use.
family_zh: 屋企人仲沉醉喺過去嘅遺憾同爭吵入面，搞到而家眼前嘅溫暖都睇唔到。
family_rev_zh: 一家人開始原諒舊帳，將目光放返喺仍然存在嘅親情上，慢慢走出喪親或決裂嘅陰霾。
family_en: The family mourns a departed member or a broken bond, staring at the spilled cups and missing the love still standing on the table.
family_rev_en: Relatives choose forgiveness, gather around the two upright cups of what remains, and rebuild rituals of connection.

mean_en: Nostalgia, childhood, innocence, reunion, simple kindness.
mean_rev_en: Stuck in the past, rose-tinted memory, leaving home, growing up, releasing old ties.
love_en: past love, romantic nostalgia, reunion with an ex, innocent affection
love_rev_en: stuck in the past, idealized memory, releasing old ties, growing up
career_en: returning to a former career, familiar workplace, mentoring others, nostalgia influencing career choices
career_rev_en: clinging to the familiar, releasing old roles, nostalgia fading, moving forward
mean_zh: 懷舊、童年、無邪、重逢、簡單的善意。
mean_rev_zh: 留戀過去、玫瑰色記憶、離開家鄉、成長、放棄舊關係。
love_zh: 過去的愛情，羈絆的浪漫懷念，與前任重逢，純粹的親情
love_rev_zh: 懶惰於過去，理想化的記憶，釋放舊關係，成長
career_zh: 回歸舊職業，熟悉的職場，輔導他人，懷舊影響職業選擇
career_rev_zh: 依戀於熟悉的事物，釋放舊角色，懷舊逐漸消逝，向前行進
health_zh: 懷念細個嗰陣精力充沛嘅身體，不妨重拾童年嘅簡單快樂（例如踩單車、食家常飯），佢就係你最好嘅心靈補藥。
health_rev_zh: 唔好沉迷喺「以前咁後生先有健康」嘅諗法，成長意味建立適合而家年齡嘅作息，放手舊有嘅健康神話。
health_en: Nostalgia for childhood vitality invites you to bring back simple joys—cycling, home-cooked meals—as gentle medicine for your whole being.
health_rev_en: Don't cling to the myth that health belongs only to youth; growing up means building routines suited to your present body and letting go of old stories.
wealth_zh: 你嘅財富同舊事掛鉤，懷念以前賺錢容易嘅日子，或者收到舊朋友／家人嘅經濟支援。可用懷舊嘅力量去重建人脈，但唔好淨係沉迷回憶。
wealth_rev_zh: 你被困喺過去嘅理財模式，帶住玫瑰色眼鏡睇以前嘅投資回報。提醒你要成長，放低舊有金錢觀念，離開舒適圈。
wealth_en: Your wealth is tied to nostalgia: you miss the days when money came easily, or you receive financial support from family and old friends. Reconnect with reassuring contacts, but don't rely on memories to pay the bills.
wealth_rev_en: You're stuck in old money patterns, looking at past returns through rose-tinted glasses. It's time to leave home, update your financial habits, and release outdated beliefs about wealth.
study_zh: 重溫舊筆記、舊試題或者基本概念，用返初學嗰種單純心態，或者接受師兄姐嘅指導，呢種熟悉而友善嘅方法會令學習穩步向前。
study_rev_zh: 太沉迷以前嘅學習模式或者過去嘅好成績，唔願接受新知識，係時候跳出舒適圈，擺脫舊習慣，學習成長。
study_en: Revisit your old notes, past papers, and fundamental concepts with a beginner's innocence, or let a senior mentor guide you—this familiar, kind approach brings steady progress.
study_rev_en: You are clinging to the old way of studying or living on past achievements; it's time to leave that comfort zone and grow into new methods and new topics.
family_zh: 返到老家翻開舊相簿，童年玩樂嘅畫面湧現，趁團聚用簡單嘅心意重溫親情。
family_rev_zh: 唔好成日沉醉喺『以前屋企好開心』嘅幻想，要識得放手，離開舊模式先可以真正長大。
family_en: Nostalgia smells like grandma's kitchen; a simple shared dish becomes the bridge that reunites distant relatives.
family_rev_en: The family romanticises the past so heavily that no one notices who has changed; release the old roles and let everyone grow.

mean_en: Choices, fantasy, illusion, wishful thinking, options.
mean_rev_en: Clarity, decision made, cutting through illusion, overwhelm ending, realism.
love_en: romantic options, fantasy and idealization, unclear intentions, difficulty choosing a partner
love_rev_en: clarity, decision made, illusions fading, realism
career_en: many career options, unrealistic expectations, scattered focus, choosing a practical path
career_rev_en: clear choice, focus returning, cutting through options, realism
mean_zh: 選擇、幻想、幻象、一廂情願、選項。
mean_rev_zh: 清晰、做出決定、穿透幻象、壓倒性的結束、現實主義。
love_zh: 愛情選擇，幻想與理想化，意圖不明確，難以選擇伴侶
love_rev_zh: 清晰，決定已定，幻覺消逝，現實主義
career_zh: 多種職業選擇，不切實際的期望，注意力分散，選擇實際的道路
career_rev_zh: 明確的選擇，注意力回歸，排除選擇，現實主義
health_zh: 眼前有成堆健康建議、療法同營養品選擇，多到眼花撩亂，小心沉迷於「神奇療法」嘅幻想而冇落實執行。
health_rev_zh: 篩走唔切實際嘅健康幻想，終於揀定一個可行嘅方案（例如固定睇醫生或運動計劃），清晰落手執行。
health_en: You're drowning in health fads, miracle cures and endless options; beware of dreaming about perfect wellness instead of taking one real step.
health_rev_en: You cut through the illusion of a magic fix, commit to one practical plan—a regular doctor, a workout schedule—and act with clarity.
wealth_zh: 面前好多賺錢選項，但好多係幻想，例如妄想一夜暴富、虛擬貨幣發達。要將每個選擇寫出利弊，分清邊個係真實邊個係幻覺。
wealth_rev_zh: 你終於從幻想中醒嚟，睇清楚邊條路可行，結束選擇困難，落實一個實際嘅財務計劃。
wealth_en: Many money options are swirling in front of you, but most are fantasies—get-rich-quick schemes, unrealistic side hustles. Write out the pros and cons of each choice and separate illusion from reality.
wealth_rev_en: The fog clears and you finally see which financial path is practical. You cut through wishful thinking, end the overwhelm, and commit to a concrete investment or saving plan.
study_zh: 面前有太多升學路、選科或者學習計劃，幻想好豐滿，但反而三心兩意，要寫低實際利弊，揀一條真正可行嘅路。
study_rev_zh: 諗通咗，終於決定到選科或者升學方向，唔再發白日夢，集中精力喺一個實際可行嘅溫習計劃上面。
study_en: You are dazzled by too many study paths, exchange programs, and career ideas, so many options become fantasy—write down the real pros and cons and pick one practical route.
study_rev_en: The fog clears and you finally make a decision about your course or major, cutting through the illusions and focusing your energy on one achievable study plan.
family_zh: 對於家庭計劃有好多憧憬同選擇，但要小心不切實際嘅幻想，唔好淨係諗而唔行動。
family_rev_zh: 一家人終於認清現實，斬走無謂選項，落實一個實際可行嘅家庭決定。
family_en: Multiple visions of the 'perfect family' float in the air—dreams of moving house, another child, a reunion—but only one choice fits the real budget.
family_rev_en: The fog clears; relatives admit what they truly need and commit to a concrete plan instead of chasing fantasy.

mean_en: Walking away, seeking deeper meaning, leaving behind, disillusionment, quest.
mean_rev_en: Fear of leaving, returning, avoidance, staying too long, unfinished departure.
love_en: walking away from a relationship, seeking deeper fulfillment, emotional detachment, leaving what no longer satisfies
love_rev_en: fear of leaving, staying too long, avoidance, unfinished departure
career_en: leaving an unfulfilling job, seeking meaningful work, career transition, moving beyond stagnation
career_rev_en: fear of leaving, staying in stagnation, avoidance, unfinished transition
mean_zh: 離開、尋求更深層的意義、放棄、幻滅、探索。
mean_rev_zh: 害怕離開、返回、逃避、逗留過久、未完成的離開。
love_zh: 離開一段關係，尋求更深層的滿足，情感抽離，離開不再滿足的事物
love_rev_zh: 離開的恐懼，停留過久，逃避，未完成的離開
career_zh: 離開不滿足的工作，尋求有意義的工作，職業轉變，超越停滯
career_rev_zh: 離開的恐懼，停留在停滯狀態，逃避，未完成的轉變
health_zh: 你已經受夠咗嗰套冇靈魂嘅養生方式或傷身嘅生活模式，係時候決心離開，去搵真正令你身心安穩嘅路。
health_rev_zh: 明明知道而家嘅生活唔健康，卻因為唔捨得舒適區而遲遲唔走，猶豫同逃避只會令身體繼續捱落去。
health_en: You've grown disillusioned with a hollow wellness routine or harmful lifestyle; now is the time to walk away and seek a path that truly nourishes you.
health_rev_en: You know your current habits are unhealthy but fear leaving your comfort zone; hesitation keeps your body stuck in the very situation you want to escape.
wealth_zh: 你對現有工作／收入來源感到空虛，決定辭職或離開穩定收入去搵更有意義嘅事業。離開前確保有半年儲蓄，唔好淨係憑感覺走。
wealth_rev_zh: 你想走但唔敢走，因為怕冇收入而繼續留喺一個消耗你嘅工作；或者離開咗又返轉頭。要完成未處理嘅財務包袱，先好走。
wealth_en: You're walking away from an unfulfilling job or income source to seek deeper meaning in your work. Before you leave, make sure you have at least six months of savings as a bridge to your next chapter.
wealth_rev_en: You want to leave a draining financial situation but fear losing income keeps you stuck, or you return to an old job after quitting. Tie up loose ends and face your money fears before making the move.
study_zh: 你覺得而家讀嘅課程已經滿足唔到自己，準備好行開，去搵一個更有深度、更有意義嘅學科，即使要離開熟悉嘅校園。
study_rev_zh: 因為怕改變而一直拖延轉系或退修嘅決定，明知唔適合都繼續留低落去，要面對真相，好好計劃點樣離開。
study_en: You sense your current course no longer feeds your mind, and you are ready to walk away and search for a deeper, more meaningful field of study, even if it means leaving the familiar campus.
study_rev_en: You keep postponing the decision to switch or quit because you fear change, so you stay in a course that drains you—face the truth and prepare your exit properly.
family_zh: 有個家人開始想離開固有嘅家庭角色，去追尋更深層嘅意義，唔好阻止，但要好好道別。
family_rev_zh: 有人明明想走又唔敢走，或者離開咗又折返，搞到關係拖住，要面對唔捨得嘅情緒。
family_en: A relative turns their back on the family script, walking away from comfortable dinners to search for a home that truly fits their soul.
family_rev_en: Someone hovers at the doorway, afraid to leave the old hurt behind, returning repeatedly because the farewell is not yet honest.

mean_en: Wishes fulfilled, contentment, satisfaction, pleasure, gratitude.
mean_rev_en: Superficial happiness, greed, unfulfilled wishes, smugness, inner lack.
love_en: romantic satisfaction, emotional pleasure, receiving desired affection, enjoying love
love_rev_en: superficial satisfaction, unmet wishes, inner lack, complacency
career_en: career satisfaction, desired professional outcome, rewarding achievement, enjoying success
career_rev_en: hollow success, unmet goals, complacency, inner dissatisfaction
mean_zh: 願望實現、滿足、滿意、快樂、感謝。
mean_rev_zh: 表面快樂、貪婪、未實現的願望、自滿、內在缺乏。
love_zh: 愛情滿足，情感快樂，收到期望的親情，享受愛情
love_rev_zh: 表面滿足，未滿足的願望，內在缺乏，自滿
career_zh: 職業滿足，期望的職業結果，獎勵性的成就，享受成功
career_rev_zh: 虛假的成功，未滿足的目標，自滿，內在的不滿
health_zh: 身體狀態令人滿意，好似願望成真，記得懷住感恩保養呢份健康，唔好因為得意就放縱自己。
health_rev_zh: 表面睇落飲食作息「扮健康」，但內裡空虛，或者自滿咁覺得冇問題，其實身體需求係咪真係俾你瞭解？
health_en: Your health feels like a wish granted—enjoy the contentment, but stay grateful and don't let satisfaction turn into complacent indulgence.
health_rev_en: You're performing 'healthy living' on the surface while neglecting inner needs, or smugly assuming you're fine without actually listening to your body.
wealth_zh: 財富願望實現，儲蓄達到目標，錢包脹卜卜，感到滿足同感恩。享受成果之餘，記得設一個新目標，保持感恩心態。
wealth_rev_zh: 表面風光但內心空虛，賺到錢但唔開心，或者因為貪心而買啲唔需要嘅嘢。要分辨真正需要定係炫耀。
wealth_en: Your wealth wishes come true: savings goals are met, your wallet feels full, and you enjoy genuine satisfaction. Celebrate and show gratitude, then set a new target to keep the momentum.
wealth_rev_en: Your prosperity looks good on the surface but feels hollow inside—spending for show or chasing more without real need. Check your true motivations and practice contentment.
study_zh: 學業心願達成，例如攞到理想成績、收到取錄或者完成論文，滿足之餘要感恩自己嘅努力，好好享受呢份成就感。
study_rev_zh: 表面睇落滿意，但內心其實唔踏實，或者不斷追求更高分數嚟滿足虛榮，要問自己最初係咪真係想學呢樣嘢。
study_en: You get the academic wish you have been working for—a target grade, an offer, or a completed thesis—so enjoy the satisfaction and write down what you are grateful for in your learning journey.
study_rev_en: You appear satisfied on the outside, but inside you feel hollow or greedy for higher marks; stop using achievement as validation and reconnect with why you wanted to learn in the first place.
family_zh: 一家人聚埋一齊，願望成真，心滿意足，記得感恩同珍惜呢一刻嘅圓滿。
family_rev_zh: 表面睇落屋企和諧美滿，但有人心底仲嫌唔夠，滿足唔到就變得好虛偽，要誠實面對內在嘅缺乏。
family_en: The dinner table is finally full—the seat you prayed for is occupied, the reconciliation happened, and satisfaction settles like warm tea.
family_rev_en: Champagne glasses clink over a perfect family portrait, but underneath someone feels empty, suspecting this happiness is just for show.

mean_en: Lasting happiness, family harmony, emotional fulfillment, love realized, belonging.

love_en: lasting happiness, emotional security, harmonious family life, fulfilled partnership
love_rev_en: family discord, broken harmony, strained bonds, unrealistic ideals
career_en: harmonious workplace, meaningful career, supportive team, long-term professional fulfillment
career_rev_en: disconnection at work, broken team harmony, misaligned values, strain
mean_zh: 持久的快樂、家庭和諧、情感滿足、愛的實現、屬於。
